target.value: all allies within 30 ft. of you

description.summary: You play a rousing march song, inspiring your allies to move and attack faster.
description.value: You play a rousing march song, inspiring your allies to move and attack faster. Each round this song is in effect, allies within 30 feet of the bard gain the Hasted status effect. Hasted: This status effect grants the character a +1 bonus to Attack rolls, +1 bonus to Reflex saves, +30 foot movement, and an extra attack if the subject uses a full-attack option. Haste counters and dispels slow.
